description: Applicants for one of the employer's jobs, or with no jobId the newest applicants across all of them (each row names its job): name, stage, fit score, applied date, plus stage counts and each applicant's newest interview (status and time) when one is set. With an email (one you already hold, for example a lead from your own form or ad) it answers whether that person applied. WITHDRAWN = the candidate withdrew the application (it cannot be moved or messaged). Contact details and resumes stay in the Jobiba dashboard.

email.description: Exact email of one person you already know, to check whether they applied. Rows never include an email.

jobId.description: Jobiba job ID (the id field from search_jobs or list_my_jobs).

name: list_applicants
title: Applicants for a job
